message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned when you finish a round by playing all your cards and then scoring the sum of the cards left in your opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On your turn you may either:
1. **Play** one or more cards that match the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** – play if same color or same number.
• **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color and the next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you risk being challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls it out before you play your last card, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the total value of all cards still held by the other players: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins. You can adjust the target for shorter or longer games. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – you can often play multiple cards in a row if you have a chain of matching colors or numbers. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – change the color to suit your hand or force opponents into a difficult position. 3. **Watch for “Draw Four” challenges** – if you suspect a player is cheating, you can challenge them. If they’re caught lying, they draw four cards; if they’re honest, you draw six. 4. **Plan your “UNO” call** – remember to shout “UNO” before the next player’s turn starts, not after you’ve finished your own turn. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
